name: sellbase
stderr:
Usage: sellbase [options] [command]

Sellbase: commerce for apps built with AI

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                 Install Sellbase into this project (Next.js,
                                 Vite + React, or any website) with Supabase
  create [options] <dir>         Start a new store from an example (Next.js
                                 store or HTML landing page)
  feedback [options]             Draft a GitHub issue for the Sellbase
                                 maintainers (bug, idea or extension). Secrets
                                 and personal data are redacted; you review and
                                 submit it.
  doctor [options]               Setup checklist with the next step for each
                                 pending item
  add [options] <components...>  Copy storefront components into
                                 components/sellbase
  seed <giro>                    Add an example catalog: ropa, curso,
                                 consultorio, cafeteria
  upgrade [options]              Update Sellbase: migrations (dry run + backup),
                                 functions, components, skills
  token                          Manage API tokens
  mcp                            Start the MCP server over stdio (configured in
                                 .mcp.json by init)
  help [command]                 display help for command
